props.title: Hotel Boulderado
props.lede: Hotel Boulderado opened with a New Year’s Eve ball in 1909, a block from Pearl Street, and couples still get married on its Grand Staircase under the stained-glass ceiling.

headingText.html: Live music is part of the hotel already. There’s jazz in the lobby on Friday evenings, and music every week downstairs at License No. 1.

rows.text: The Boulderado Ballroom is about 2,900 sq ft, for dinners of up to 180 and receptions of up to 250. The ceiling is lower than most ballrooms, at about 8 ft 8 in.

The Mezzanine Lounge is about 3,300 sq ft under the stained-glass ceiling, for dinners of up to 80 and receptions of up to 110. Ceremonies happen on the Grand Staircase, with up to 180 guests watching from the Mezzanine.
Columbine-Balsam is about 2,200 sq ft, for dinners of up to 120 and receptions of up to 175, and Columbine on its own holds dinners of up to 80.
Spruce Farm & Fish and the Corner Bar each host private brunches and dinners of up to 30.

props.title: Live music for a ceremony on the Grand Staircase
props.lede: It’s the hotel’s classic ceremony, with your guests on the Mezzanine.

props.title: Live music in the Mezzanine and the Boulderado Ballroom
props.lede: They’re the spaces for the cocktail hour, the reception and holiday parties.

rows.text: Our acts bring their own sound system, sized to the space. The ballroom’s ceiling is low, so we size the band and the sound to fit it.
The hotel caters every event in-house, and its wedding packages include a dance floor.
There’s jazz in the lobby on Friday evenings, so we’ll plan your music around it.
The hotel lights a 29-foot Christmas tree in the lobby each year, and it hosts holiday teas and buffets.
Parking at the hotel is valet only, with street parking nearby.

props.title: Ask about your date at Hotel Boulderado.
props.lede: Send us your date, and we can put together live music for your event at the hotel, from strings on the Grand Staircase to a band in the ballroom.
